subject: Physics
rule: A gate may claim scope_class PRESCRIBED only when an exact binding below matches its board, grade, chapter and the full gate set declared for that chapter. A loose reference, a syllabus link or a file that merely exists is not authority. Missing binding fails closed as HELD_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY.
adapted_from: physics-curriculum-scope-bindings.v1.json in reallaksh19/Common PR #350, which reached the same fail-closed posture and likewise carries an empty binding set for this material.
empty_set_is_deliberate: No exact CBSE binding has been established for quantitative two-dimensional vector and relative-velocity work at grade 9. Every gate in motion-vectors.v1.json is therefore declared OWNER_EXTENSION rather than PRESCRIBED. Fabricating a binding to make the registry look complete is the specific failure this registry exists to prevent.
